heading.en: From a test tube to a factory

hook.en: A few bacteria making human insulin are useless to a hospital. We need thousands of litres of culture, kept sterile, and a pure, safe medicine at the end.
hook.kn: ಮಾನವ ಇನ್ಸುಲಿನ್ ತಯಾರಿಸುವ ಕೆಲವು ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾಗಳು ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಗೆ ಸಾಲದು. ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಲೀಟರ್ ನಿರ್ಜಂತುಕ ಸಂವರ್ಧನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಶುದ್ಧ, ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ ಔಷಧ ಬೇಕು.

objectives.en: Explain how transformed cells are selected
List the steps of downstream processing

narration.en: A few bacteria making human insulin are useless to a hospital. We need thousands of litres of culture, kept sterile, and a pure, safe medicine at the end.
narration.kn: ಮಾನವ ಇನ್ಸುಲಿನ್ ತಯಾರಿಸುವ ಕೆಲವು ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾಗಳು ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಗೆ ಸಾಲದು. ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಲೀಟರ್ ನಿರ್ಜಂತುಕ ಸಂವರ್ಧನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಶುದ್ಧ, ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ ಔಷಧ ಬೇಕು.

title.en: Insertion and expression of the gene

body.en: Recombinant DNA is transferred into competent host cells. If it carries an antibiotic-resistance gene (for example ampicillin), the cells are spread on agar plates containing ampicillin; only transformants grow, and untransformed cells die. When a protein-encoding gene is expressed in a heterologous host, the product is called a recombinant protein. Cells can be grown in small laboratory cultures, or in a continuous culture system where used medium is drained from one side while fresh medium is added from the other, keeping the cells in their physiologically most active log (exponential) phase, which gives a larger biomass and more of the desired protein.

points.en: Recombinant protein: expressed in a heterologous host
Continuous culture keeps cells in the log phase

narration.en: Only cells that took up the plasmid survive on antibiotic plates. A protein made from a foreign gene in a host is a recombinant protein, and continuous culture keeps the cells in their most productive log phase.
narration.kn: ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಮಿಡ್ ಪಡೆದ ಕೋಶಗಳು ಮಾತ್ರ ಪ್ರತಿಜೀವಕ ತಟ್ಟೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬದುಕುತ್ತವೆ. ಆತಿಥೇಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊರಗಿನ ಜೀನಿನಿಂದ ತಯಾರಾದ ಪ್ರೋಟೀನ್ ಪುನರ್ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ಪ್ರೋಟೀನ್; ನಿರಂತರ ಸಂವರ್ಧನೆ ಕೋಶಗಳನ್ನು ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಉತ್ಪಾದಕ ಲಾಗ್ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: A stirred-tank bioreactor is a large vessel, 100 to 1000 litres, with a curved base so that the contents mix well. A motor-driven agitator keeps stirring.
Sterile air is bubbled in through a sparger at the bottom, so every cell gets oxygen.
Probes and pumps hold the pH and temperature steady, a foam-control system stops frothing, and sampling ports let us check the culture.
After growth comes downstream processing: separation and purification, formulation with preservatives, then clinical trials and strict quality control.
In continuous culture, used medium is drained and fresh medium added, so the cells stay in their fast log phase and give more product.

text.en: Continuous culture: cells stay in log phase

narration.en: A stirred-tank bioreactor is a large vessel, 100 to 1000 litres, with a curved base so that the contents mix well. A motor-driven agitator keeps stirring. Sterile air is bubbled in through a sparger at the bottom, so every cell gets oxygen. Probes and pumps hold the pH and temperature steady, a foam-control system stops frothing, and sampling ports let us check the culture. After growth comes downstream processing: separation and purification, formulation with preservatives, then clinical trials and strict quality control. In continuous culture, used medium is drained and fresh medium added, so the cells stay in their fast log phase and give more product.
A bioreactor keeps a large culture at the best temperature, pH and oxygen supply. Find the part that does each job.

prompt.en: Drag each label to its part of the sparged stirred-tank bioreactor.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೆಸರನ್ನು ಜೈವಿಕ ರಿಯಾಕ್ಟರ್‌ನ ಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಎಳೆಯಿರಿ.

explanation.en: The motor turns flat-bladed impellers that mix the broth and spread oxygen; the sparger releases sterile air as bubbles; the foam breaker controls foam; acid or base controls pH; steam sterilises the vessel and the jacket controls temperature; the sampling port lets small volumes be drawn out.
explanation.kn: ಮೋಟಾರ್, ಇಂಪೆಲ್ಲರ್, ಸ್ಪಾರ್ಜರ್, ನೊರೆ ಒಡೆಯುವ ಸಾಧನ, pH ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ, ಹಬೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾದರಿ ದ್ವಾರ.

body.en: Large volumes of culture (100–1000 litres) are processed in bioreactors, which provide the optimal conditions for the desired product: temperature, pH, substrate, salts, vitamins and oxygen. The most commonly used is the stirred-tank bioreactor, usually cylindrical or with a curved base to help mixing; the stirrer mixes the contents and makes oxygen available throughout. In a sparged stirred-tank bioreactor, sterile air bubbles are sparged through the culture. A bioreactor has an agitator system, an oxygen delivery system, a foam control system, a temperature control system, a pH control system and sampling ports from which small volumes of culture can be withdrawn periodically.

points.en: Stirred-tank: cylindrical or curved base for mixing
Systems: agitator, oxygen, foam, temperature, pH; sampling ports

narration.en: Bioreactors grow 100 to 1000 litres of culture under controlled temperature, pH and oxygen. The common stirred-tank bioreactor has a stirrer, air spargers, foam control, temperature and pH control, and sampling ports.
narration.kn: ಜೈವಿಕ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಕಾರಕಗಳು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿತ ತಾಪ, pH ಮತ್ತು ಆಮ್ಲಜನಕದಲ್ಲಿ 100 ರಿಂದ 1000 ಲೀಟರ್ ಸಂವರ್ಧನೆ ಬೆಳೆಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಕಲಕುವ-ತೊಟ್ಟಿ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಕಾರಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಲಕುವ ಸಾಧನ, ಗಾಳಿ ಸ್ಪಾರ್ಜರ್, ನೊರೆ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ, ತಾಪ ಮತ್ತು pH ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಹಾಗೂ ಮಾದರಿ ದ್ವಾರಗಳಿವೆ.

body.en: After biosynthesis, the product has to go through a series of processes before it can be marketed; together these are called downstream processing. The two main steps are separation and purification. The product is then formulated with suitable preservatives. For drugs, the formulation must undergo thorough clinical trials, and strict quality control testing is required for each product. Downstream processing and quality control differ from product to product.

narration.en: Downstream processing turns the raw culture into a product: separation and purification, formulation with preservatives, and for medicines, clinical trials and strict quality control.
narration.kn: ಡೌನ್‌ಸ್ಟ್ರೀಮ್ ಸಂಸ್ಕರಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸುವಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಶುದ್ಧೀಕರಣ, ಸಂರಕ್ಷಕಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸೂತ್ರೀಕರಣ, ಮತ್ತು ಔಷಧಗಳಿಗೆ ಕ್ಲಿನಿಕಲ್ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಕಟ್ಟುನಿಟ್ಟಾದ ಗುಣಮಟ್ಟ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

aim.en: To plot the growth curve of a bacterial culture and find its specific growth rate and generation time.

narration.en: Grow bacteria in a flask, the way a bioreactor does on a large scale. Find the lag, log and stationary phases, and see why industry wants to keep cells in the log phase.

caption.en: In a batch culture, cells grow in an S-shaped curve and stop when nutrients run out. Continuous culture keeps them in the steep middle part, where product forms fastest.

label.en: Time to reach half of maximum

problem.en: Put these steps of making recombinant insulin in order: (A) separation and purification; (B) growing transformed E. coli in a bioreactor; (C) clinical trials and quality control; (D) selecting transformants on ampicillin plates; (E) formulation with preservatives.

steps.en: First pick out the cells that received the plasmid: D.
Grow them on a large scale: B.
Then downstream processing: separate and purify (A), formulate (E).
